children: Variational said on its official Discord channel that a wallet-connection update will log out all users during a maintenance window expected at 3:00 (UTC+8) on Friday, October 23, 2026. Users will need to log in again through a new process to view their positions and resume trading.

According to Odaily, community members speculate that the update may introduce a trading API, based on Variational’s previously announced development schedule. Since Variational distributes points every Friday, some community members also suggest that an API launch could increase trading volume and affect how efficiently users earn points.

title: Variational May Activate Trading API Next Friday, Community Speculates
